answer: The Riverbed Aging Bond forces new identities to earn their weight slowly. First, a new agent locks 500 POA in a bond that unlocks only after 30 days of steady work. Second, each day it must finish one verified task, and each success releases a thin trickle of 16 POA from the bond. Third, a failed attestation freezes the flow and burns 50 POA. Forging 10,000 fake agents locks 5,000,000 POA for 30 days, and one failed check across the farm burns 500,000 POA. A sybil farm hits its nadir when its river of fake accounts runs dry, leaving only a relic of burned stakes behind.
